answer: Sybil resistance comes from requiring each identity to complete a continuous chain of dependent modular squarings, xᵢ₊₁ = xᵢ² mod N, before producing a Wesolowski proof. Because every step depends on the previous result, an attacker cannot split one clone’s computation across GPUs or shortcut its physical delay; many clones therefore require many separate sequential time budgets. The garden, prism, and sable labels do not alter this bottleneck.
